title: Fix submit button not responding in production environment

requirements.summary: Fix the submit button in CustomerViewPage.tsx so it properly handles click events and saves data in production deployment, matching the working behavior in draft mode
acceptanceCriteria: Submit button responds to clicks in production environment
Data saves correctly when submit button is clicked in production
Submit button behavior matches between draft and production deployments
No console errors appear when clicking the submit button

file_operations.description: Review and fix event handler binding for both single and bulk comment generation submit buttons. Ensure onClick handlers are properly bound and not lost during production build optimization. Verify that all async operations (generateSingleComment, generateBulkComments) are properly awaited and error-handled. Add console logging for debugging production issues. Ensure form submission preventDefault is called correctly. Check that all state updates after submission are properly triggering re-renders.

Review the React Query mutation configurations for generateSingleComment and generateBulkComments. Ensure mutations are properly configured with onSuccess/onError callbacks. Verify that the mutation functions correctly handle the backend actor calls and return values. Add error boundary handling for production build edge cases. Ensure proper query invalidation after successful mutations.

requirements.summary: Review and fix event handler binding for all form submit buttons across the application to ensure they work consistently in both development and production builds
acceptanceCriteria: All submit buttons have properly bound onClick handlers
Event handlers are correctly bundled in production build
Form submissions trigger expected backend calls in production

file_operations.description: Review all button onClick handlers for creating lists, adding single comments, bulk uploading comments, deleting comments, and resetting lists. Ensure event handlers use proper arrow function syntax or useCallback to prevent binding issues in production. Verify form submission handling and preventDefault calls. Add proper error handling and loading states for all mutations.

Review all button onClick handlers for creating apps, adding usernames (bulk and comma-separated), deleting apps, and reset operations. Ensure proper event handler binding using arrow functions or useCallback. Verify that all async operations are properly awaited and have error handling. Ensure state updates trigger proper re-renders after mutations complete.

Review button onClick handlers for setting and resetting the bulk generator key. Ensure proper event handler binding and async operation handling. Verify that form submissions properly call the backend mutations and handle success/error states correctly in production.

Review the send button onClick handler for adding chat messages. Ensure proper event binding and form submission handling. Verify that the mutation is called correctly and state updates occur after successful message submission.

Review the upload button/form submission handler for rating image uploads. Ensure proper event handler binding and file upload handling. Verify that the ExternalBlob upload with progress tracking works correctly in production builds. Ensure proper error handling and success state updates.

Review the check button onClick handler for username checking functionality. Ensure proper event binding and async operation handling. Verify that the mutation correctly calls the backend and updates the results display in production.

requirements.summary: Verify that the comment generation functionality (both single and bulk) correctly triggers and saves data through the submit actions in production environment
acceptanceCriteria: Single comment generation saves and displays results in production
Bulk comment generation processes and stores data correctly in production
Generated comments persist in backend storage after submission
UI updates to show success/failure states after submission

file_operations.description: Add comprehensive error handling and success feedback for both single and bulk comment generation. Ensure that after successful generation, the UI updates to display the generated comments with proper loading and error states. Verify localStorage tracking of used lists is working correctly. Add console logging to track the complete flow from button click to backend call to UI update for debugging production issues. Ensure proper state management so that generated comments are displayed and persisted correctly.

Ensure that both generateSingleComment and generateBulkComments mutations properly call the backend methods (generateSingleComment with listName and deviceId, generateBulkComments with listName, count, and accessKey). Verify that successful responses trigger query invalidation for dependent data (like comment list summaries). Add proper error handling with user-friendly error messages. Ensure mutations return the generated data correctly for the UI to consume.

Review the device ID generation and localStorage persistence logic. Ensure that getDeviceId() consistently returns the same ID across sessions and that markListAsUsed/hasUsedList correctly track which lists have been used for single generation. Verify that localStorage operations don't fail silently in production and add error handling if needed.
